label: preparing
what: A secret surprise service jubilee for the mayor in the great hall at eighteen on day 1, with 200 fresh loaves and eight lanterns. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated bread, lighting and a discreet escort under the cover of a lighting inspection. Baker knowingly helped by supplying eighty loaves and explicitly agreeing to keep the occasion private. No evidence that secretary or neighbour knew the true purpose; the mayor was told about a lighting inspection, not the jubilee.
